insight: Founded in 2015 as ZEIT by Next.js and Socket.IO creator Guillermo Rauch, and rebranded to Vercel in April 2020.
name: Vercel
tagline: Frontend cloud for React/Next. Edge functions + image opt + analytics.
description: Next.js-native hosting with fast deploys, edge functions, image optimization, and a free Speed Insights tier. Strong default for the React/Next ecosystem.
edge: Productized Next.js: git-push to a global edge network, with the AI SDK and v0 generation in one account.
pros: Global edge network + per-PR preview URLs
cons: Costs can scale steeply at high traffic
Best fit is the Next.js ecosystem
